name: warrior pose virabhadrasana v. 2
description: A wide lunge with arms stretched to the sides. It strengthens the legs and builds stamina.
instructions: Stand with feet wide and turn your front foot out.
Bend the front knee over the ankle.
Extend your arms out to the sides at shoulder height.
Turn your head to look over the front hand.
Hold for 5 breaths, then switch sides.
